verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is itself a headless HTTP API. It creates asynchronous jobs from URLs or file uploads and reports completion through webhooks or status polling. Its docs advise creating a dedicated API key per script or pipeline, and it provides auth-test and health endpoints plus an OpenAPI spec, which together support unattended automation and CI use. Missing for 10: a CI-specific guide or official CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration of pipeline use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Transcribes prerecorded audio and video files through an API.
Create a dedicated API key for each agent, script, or pipeline.
Applications create transcription jobs and can receive completion updates through webhooks.
GET /v2/jobs/health endpoint to check the health of the service
GET /v2/jobs/auth endpoint to test the authentication
